evaluation: same 10 training videos; overfit only, no holdout or generalization estimate
preprocessing: 1 fps from zero plus actual decision endpoint; PTS <= observation time; aspect-preserving 256px pad
backbone: frozen vision and language weights; cached per-frame features only within this run
known_memory_behavior: Preserve validated implementation: first-eviction initialization overlaps subsequent FIFO eviction updates.
timing_label_source: existing gold WAIT/ANSWER timestamps retained by user preference; not paper pseudo-label regions
timing_timeline: same frozen annotated endpoints sorted per task, irregular intervals; source-style adjacent-score TV over these sampled endpoints, not dense 1fps readiness supervision
timing_pair_sampling: official readiness_loss sampler per valid question, max_pairs64; with 1ANSWER draws 1WAIT pair per question/update; eval exact all-pairs expectation
answer_scoring: Official readiness_vqa.answers_match plus historical exact-match; sparse-first-trigger diagnostics, no ARS
initialization: Original pinned Qwen3.5-2B + bert-base-uncased + InstructBLIP QFormer weights; fresh projections/fusion/RDY; no ultrasound checkpoint or Adam restore
comparison_protocol: Identical original pretrained weights, seeded new modules, fresh Adam step0, no warmup optimizer update, identical batches/per-step seeds;100epochs300updates per arm
timing_unpaired_policy: BCE-containing objectives supervise all endpoints; pure CL has no pair loss for single-label tasks; temporal term unchanged
